updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to access Microsoft Defender for Endpoint public APIs

User impact: Users may be unable to access Microsoft Defender for Endpoint public APIs. 

Current status: We’ve investigated a problem with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint in which users were unable to access public APIs, and we’ve confirmed that service is now restored. We’ll provide additional information in a closure summary within the “History” section of the “Service health” dashboard shortly.
